verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for an email-delivery service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Mailgun publishing its service source under an open license. SDKs, the MCP server and llms.txt are documented, but none is described as open-source or licensed, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
